hal_wake.speaker: hal
hal_wake.text: Habitat systems online. Shift duration is 300 seconds.

hal_welcome_back.speaker: hal
hal_welcome_back.text: Warning. Previous shift records indicate unauthorized button activation.

hal_alarm_reactor.speaker: hal
hal_alarm_reactor.text: Warning. Reactor core anomaly detected. Meltdown in 45 seconds.

hal_alarm_power.speaker: hal
hal_alarm_power.text: Warning. Main electrical failure. Total blackout in 40 seconds.

hal_alarm_o2.speaker: hal
hal_alarm_o2.text: Warning. Oxygen depletion detected. Atmospheric loss in 50 seconds.

hal_warning_10.speaker: hal
hal_warning_10.text: Critical alert. 10 seconds remaining until catastrophic failure.

hal_death.speaker: hal
hal_death.text: Life support terminated. Crew member deceased.

hal_flare_hit.speaker: hal
hal_flare_hit.text: Solar particle event in progress. Radiation has disrupted the power grid.

hal_button_1.speaker: hal
hal_button_1.text: Notice. You have pressed the prohibited control.

hal_button_2.speaker: hal
hal_button_2.text: Notice. You have pressed the prohibited control again despite explicit warnings.

hal_button_3.speaker: hal
hal_button_3.text: Notice. Repeated activation of the prohibited control indicates total disregard for protocol.

crew_wake.speaker: crew
crew_wake.text: Hey, I'm Sam, stuck over in module B! I'll guide you through this shift over the radio.

crew_hint_reactor.speaker: crew
crew_hint_reactor.text: Reactor trouble! Get to the center console and match the sequence.

crew_hint_power.speaker: crew
crew_hint_power.text: Power's out! Breaker box by the north door. Open the cover, flip the main breaker off, then back on.

crew_hint_o2.speaker: crew
crew_hint_o2.text: Oxygen leak! Hurry to the left console and enter the override code.

crew_fixed_reactor.speaker: crew
crew_fixed_reactor.text: Reactor core stabilized! Fantastic job under pressure.

crew_fixed_power.speaker: crew
crew_fixed_power.text: Power grid restored! Nice work resetting those breakers.

crew_fixed_o2.speaker: crew
crew_fixed_o2.text: Oxygen pressure normalized! Good breathing room again.

crew_shift_done.speaker: crew
crew_shift_done.text: Shift complete! You kept us alive for the whole five minutes, excellent work!

hal_alarm_co2.speaker: hal
hal_alarm_co2.text: Warning. Carbon dioxide concentration rising. Crew impairment in 45 seconds.

crew_hint_co2.speaker: crew
crew_hint_co2.text: CO2 is climbing! Right console. Build the scrubber adapter and follow the checklist in order.

crew_fixed_co2.speaker: crew
crew_fixed_co2.text: Scrubber is pulling the CO2 down. That was an Apollo 13 move right there.

crew_tutorial_1.speaker: crew
crew_tutorial_1.text: Something is wrong with the oxygen. Do not panic, I will walk you through it. Follow the flashing marker to the left console.

crew_tutorial_2.speaker: crew
crew_tutorial_2.text: That is it. Look at the keyboard and press E.

crew_tutorial_3.speaker: crew
crew_tutorial_3.text: Read the filter code and type it in. Careful. One wrong digit vents the air.

crew_tutorial_done.speaker: crew
crew_tutorial_done.text: Perfect. From now on HAL runs a countdown, so be quick.
